definition: the study of the earth's surface
description: Three young people doing fieldwork in a wide glacial river valley under a stormy grey sky. A young woman in a blue jacket and waders stands in the pale blue water holding a tall striped measuring pole. A young man in a mustard fleece throws an orange float into the current, loses his balance and falls into the river, ending up sitting in the water, while a young woman in a maroon jacket and beige hat holds a measuring tape stretched across the river. A clipboard and backpacks lie on the stones, and snowy mountains and a glacier rise behind.

taps.target: the woman in the beige hat
